name: Family Deluxe Room
description: Premium family deluxe room for up to 8 persons with attached bathroom. Perfect for families visiting Rameswaram with AC, hot water and all modern amenities.

faqs.question: How many people can stay in a Family Deluxe Room?
faqs.answer: The Family Deluxe Room can comfortably accommodate up to 8 persons.

faqs.question: Does the room have an attached bathroom?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Family Deluxe Room comes with a private attached bathroom.

faqs.question: Are AC and Non-AC variants available?
faqs.answer: Yes, both AC and Non-AC variants of the Family Deluxe Room are available.

faqs.question: How far is the room from Ramanathaswamy Temple?
faqs.answer: Just 8.4 km away, approximately 15–16 minutes by car from our property.
